kitDescription: Rei is a Wind AR Attacker whose burst puts her into a 10-second 'Attack State': she gains Attack Damage ▲35.9% plus a large flat ATK grant (63.36% of her own ATK), and deals a 990.2% ATK nuke to all enemies at cast. While Attack State is up, every 7 normal attacks she lands fires a 286.37% ATK bonus hit. Whenever any Full Burst begins, she grants the whole team a flat ATK buff equal to 11.61% of her ATK for 10 seconds. The rest of her kit is collab-coupled: an every-18-hits 590.64% rider that only works on targets holding the externally-applied 'Anti A.T. Field' status (inert without an Eva teammate), a team buff that only reaches allies in 'Annihilation State' (no in-scope carrier), and a Machine-Gun ramp-up speed buff for MG allies who have burst. In any non-Evangelion comp her effective kit is the burst self-buffs, the nuke, the team ATK buff, and the burst-windowed 7-hit rider.

verdictRationale: All 11 kit lines are FAITHFUL (6) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (5) with reasons, ⚑ tiers, and recipes recorded; no undocumented divergence exists. The single cross-agent encoding difference — the Attack-State gate on the 7-hit rider (driver: burst-applied boss targetStatus proxy matching the exact 10s window; S6: fbGate+ownBurstGate FB-window proxy) — is benign: both are sanctioned proxies for the missing self-status primitive, the driver's is duration-exact, the S5 blind suite's gated-vs-ungated discriminator passes against it unmodified, and the proxy plus its name side-channel are documented in the override caveats. Convergence is strong where it matters: the two highest-risk misreads (casterAtkPct vs atkPct on the team buff; burstCast vs fullBurstEnter on the self-mode) are pinned by independent blind assertions with working counterfactuals in both suites, and the collab-gated lines are proven inert by removal-delta rather than assumed. Residual for owner spot-check (same-model caveat): (a) the 'Attack State' boss-targetStatus is a side channel any future requiresTargetStatus 'Attack State' on another unit could read — inert today but worth replacing with a requiresOwnBuff primitive if one lands; (b) the hitCount:7 counter is cumulative across windows rather than reset at each window start (⚑-flagged, same approximation as asuka-wille); (c) the shipped cadence tuple (720 rpm / 60 ammo / reloadFrames 111) is unverified datamine for this collab AR (⚑4) — a focus-video rounds-per-minute read is the cheapest outstanding measurement. None of these block GO.
